title: DeKalb County police looking for suspects in illegal fridge dump
text:
ATLANTA, Ga. (Atlanta News First) — DeKalb County police are asking for your help finding two men suspected of illegally dumping an entire refrigerator.

Police said two men pulled up to a home in the 6500 block of Brannon Hill Road Aug. 16 in a white Honda Odyssey, dropped off the refrigerator and left it behind.

One of the men has been identified as Ali Muta-Ali, 31.

Anyone with information should contact DeKalb County police.
